answer: Standard workflow, already stated: task is parked in desk/drawer with status: deferred (drawer frontmatter line 3); Resolved Decisions say the supervisor promotes and commits before dispatch. Not a defect.

`_one_artifact_match` (operations.py:2203) receives precomputed matches and is called only from `_resolve_artifact_selector` (:2120,:2125); it cannot become a one-line delegation to resolve_selector, which does its own globbing, and is dead once that method delegates. Fix: state it is deleted.

Tier 1 short-circuits: `if exact:` handles it before the prefix list is built (operations.py:2097-2101 and 2119-2122). So tier 2 runs only when tier 1 is empty; one exact match beats any longer prefix; >1 exact raises ValueError.

Yes. `_resolve_artifact_selector_multi` unions candidates from every directory, then raises 'Ambiguous ...' when len(exact)>1 (operations.py:2092-2101). Same name/stem in two directories is ambiguity.

Absolute paths under desk_root. Callers pass `self.desk_root / ...` (operations.py:434-435,703-705,1360); desk_root = root.resolve()/'desk' (:316-317); messages use p.relative_to(self.desk_root) (:2100,2105,2109).

Multi sorts each directory then concatenates (operations.py:2094), so its candidates are not globally sorted; single-dir sorts fully (:2117); display is str(relative_to(desk_root)), POSIX case-sensitive. Fix: state the key (e.g. sort the union by relative path) or candidate order will change.

pattern is the per-directory filename glob collecting candidates: `_resolve_glob` uses non-recursive directory.glob(f"{doc_id}*.md") (operations.py:2081); artifact selectors use rglob(pattern) (e.g. 'task-*.md', '*.md') (:2094,2117), depth unbounded.

Artifact selectors pass the id: 'artifact.task' (:434,1166), 'artifact.atom' (:708,721,819), 'artifact.pill' (:435,1360). `_resolve_glob` callers all pass desk_root/'tasks' (:674,955,1964), so what='task' is accurate.

Tier 1 compares `selector in {path.name, path.stem}` (operations.py:2096-2097). 'foo.md' has name 'foo.md', stem 'foo'; an extensionless file 'foo' has name=stem='foo', so it matches. No special case.

Not a conflict: tests/test_cli_contract.py does not exist; F1 covers only uncovered subcommands (add faq-doc, atoms list/show, runtime*), none emitting these messages. Existing asserts (test_cli.py:1284,1301) are prefixes that survive. Only the empty-selector ValueError (:2290-2291) must be kept.

Destination is the run-dir evidence: closeout requires board.txt, task.txt, git-status.txt, result-summary.md (deskops/cli/commands/closeout.py:24). Record the reworded-test list in runs/subagents/<run-dir>/result-summary.md; the run-dir value is dispensed at dispatch.

grep 'glob(\|rglob(' still matches ~10 non-selector sites (operations.py:484,513,577,1298,1321,1323,1331,1690,1719,2132), so 'no selector-resolution loop' is judgment, not a check. Fix: scope the grep to the four method bodies or list the allowed sites.
